title: Credential promotion precise OpenAPI contract preservation

phases.objective: Preserve the exact tenant credential-promotion safety contract through generated OpenAPI refreshes and allow only an operationId-pinned migration from the legacy inline path item.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Precise contract registry sync evaluates an occupied legacy inline path
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact legacy operationId is replaced by the canonical fragment ref without reformatting adjacent paths, while mismatched identities fail closed.
steps: Register the canonical path-item ref with the exact legacy operationId allowlist.
Report the matching inline path as a pending migration in read-only mode.
Apply the migration only in explicit write mode.
Re-run check mode against the composed root document.
Reject a mismatched inline operationId without rewriting the root document.
assertions: Only the exact registered legacy operationId is eligible for migration.
The canonical report discloses migration candidates and completed migrations.
A mismatched occupied path remains a fail-closed conflict.

e2e_journeys.actor: admin credential-promotion caller and repository reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Credential promotion route, tool registration, canonical OpenAPI fragment, and root composition are evaluated together
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The documented operation remains tenant-only and explicitly proves no secret copy, no token return, no platform-wide promotion, bounded preflight failure, and idempotent invocation.
steps: Verify the runtime route performs active-source preflight and tenant-only ownership checks.
Verify the maintenance tool remains approval-gated and tagged no-secrets/no-secret-copy.
Verify the root OpenAPI path resolves through the precise canonical fragment.
Verify request, success, and source-not-resolved response contracts retain the safety evidence fields.
assertions: Secret material is never requested, decrypted, copied, or returned.
Promotion approval and reason remain required.
The resulting owner type remains tenant.
Both header and canonical body idempotency forms are documented.
The source-not-resolved condition is documented as a 409 response.

phases.objective: Publish precise-contract migration identity and safety assertions in canonical generated-artifact evidence.
Exercise malformed registries, duplicate operationIds, and interrupted write verification.
Observe the guarded migration on representative legacy inline contracts before broader adoption.
Require exact precise-contract preservation for protected production-promotion readiness.
